name: aniovp
stages_using_it: all (price base of every real figure)
notes: Present-value / constant-price year. profile.do:212-214 first derives it from the system date and then overwrites it with 2027.

name: anioPE
stages_using_it: all (policy year; anchors LIF/PEF of that year)
notes: Year of the Paquete Económico. Hard-coded; FiscalGap end = anioPE+5 (SIM.do:528).

name: anioenigh
notes: ENIGH vintage. GastoPC.ado:66-74 and PerfilesSim.do:14-38 re-derive it from anioPE.

name: idbase
column11: Web always reads Ricardo's base scenario artefacts.

name: bootstrap
column11: Web/SIM §7 call Simulador with bootstrap(1) explicitly (SIM.do:510).

name: algebra
notes: Closed form replaces micro tabstat; author reports only floating-point-order differences (FiscalGap.ado:63-70).

name: nographs / textbook / rawwip / hasta / export / update / output
plausible_range_if_stated: nographs+output on in web; all off in SIM.do except algebra
column11: hasta = early stop after section N.

name: lambda
notes: If $lambda exists it overrides the historical productivity growth.

name: pensiones_en_yl
notes: CUAD-0 signed flags (10). Any non-default value is a declared FLAG and breaks baseline comparability.

name: nta_anclaS
notes: NTA module parameters (9); affect only the NTA pages, not the fiscal projection.

name: pib2026..pib2032 (7)
notes: profile.do carries a different, older vector (pib2025..2031) — stale duplicate. Positional contract with the web form (output.do:3-13).

name: ISRASPIB
column11: Revenue scenario: 15 items. Default values typed from CGPE 2027 / LIF. If absent, TasasEfectivas takes LIF observed (TasasEfectivas.ado:32-45).

name: ISR[1..11
notes: only if moduloCambio=1); Households.do uses its own year-specific tables (342-421)

name: ISR[1..11
default_value: matrix cell (hard-coded; CF recomputed in ISR_Mod)
column10: ISR_Mod.do:14-20 rebuilds lower limits and fixed quotas from the rates typed by the user.

name: SE[1..11
column10: Note: web page defines SE0..SE11 (12 ids, index.php) but the template consumes SE0..SE10.

name: DED[1
column12: DED[1,3] and DED[1,4] are informality rates applied as ranking cut-offs.

name: CSS_IMSS[1..7
column11: Two copies: SIM.do/Web.Stata.do and Households.do:1572-1580 (identical values today).

name: CSS_ISSSTE[1..8
plausible_range_if_stated: % of SBC; federal cells in pesos/UMA units
column10: The two copies DIFFER: SIM.do row 1 col 3 = 391.0 and row 8 = cuota social 13.9; Households.do row 1-2 col 3 = 13.90 and rows 6-7 split retiro/cesantía. Not reconciled in source.

name: IVAT[2..12
column11: Categories: Alimentos, Alquiler, Canasta básica, Educación, Fuera del hogar, Mascotas, Medicinas, Toallas, Otros, Transporte local, Transporte foráneo.

name: IVAT[13
column10: Two different defaults in source. SIM.do comment: recalibrated 2026-10-06.

name: IEPST[1..17
user_facing_web: Expenditure.do §6 (batch); defined but not consumed in Web.Stata.do (no IEPS submodule)
column10: Three copies with different row sets; only Expenditure.do's 10-row table is actually used in a computation (Expenditure.do:1280-1297).

name: tasaEfectiva
default_value: 10.8 (form default, index.php:2276); batch: mean of last 5 years
notes: Batch run has no scalar → FiscalGap uses the 5-year mean (764-769).

name: iniciaA
notes: Spending scenario: 34 items (education 10, health 7, pensions 5, energy 5, other 4, transfers 3). GastoPC falls back to PEF of anioPE when the scalar is undefined (e.g. GastoPC.ado:341-358).

name: gascosto
stages_using_it: GastoPC §7.2; FiscalGap.ado:772-783 (debt cost anchor of anioPE)

name: shrfsp[1
user_facing_web: SHRFSP.ado:107-118 (override observed series for 2026-2032); FiscalGap §5 (anchor 2027 only; later years overwritten by the engine)
column10: CGPE exogenous debt path. Hard-coded in both entry points; horizon 2026-2032 is a positional contract.

name: rfsp[1..7
units: RFSP total, PIDIREGAS, IPAB, FONADIN, Deudores, Banca, Adecuaciones, Balance
user_facing_web: SHRFSP §4; FiscalGap §5.8-5.9 (non-balance components frozen at last observed % GDP)

name: tipoDeCambio[1
user_facing_web: SHRFSP §4; FiscalGap §5.7 (FX effect on external debt)

name: balprimario[1
column10: Not used by FiscalGap's projection (balance is recomputed).

name: FiscalGap demographic/effective-rate windows
column10: mean growth of contribuyentes; mean tasaEfectiva; mean depreciation

name: FiscalGap actualizacion base year
notes: geometric revaluation factor of debt stocks

name: PIBDeflactor aniomax()/geopib()/geodef()/discount()
stages_using_it: PIB projection horizon; geometric windows; pibYVP

name: WorkingAge definition
stages_using_it: λ (output per working-age person) and GDP projection beyond exogenous years

name: Simulador bandwidth()/cluster()/age cap
notes: kernel graphs only; bootstrap resampling unit; profile age cap

name: Simulador normalisation
stages_using_it: PERF profile scale (cancels in REC projection)

name: smdf (UMA / minimum wage)
column17: Typed per ENIGH vintage. 2022 value (96.22) looks like a UMA 2022 (96.22) while 2024 (248.93) is the 2024 minimum wage, not the UMA (108.57): not determinable from source which concept is intended.

name: LISR exemption multiples
column12: 40/423 SM agrí; 5 SM horas; 30/15/15/30 SM; 90 SM×años; 9 SM pensions; 3 SM; 20 SM; 700k UDIs
column17: Legal constants from LISR art. 74/93; should be a table by year.

name: personal deduction caps
default_value: funeral ≤ 1 UMA×360; colegiaturas 14,200/12,900/19,900/17,100/24,500; total ≤ min(5 UMA, 15 % income)

name: GastoPC age thresholds
plausible_range_if_stated: edad<=15 básica; <3 primera infancia; <4/<6 madres; >=65 PAM; >=65 dependencia

name: ISR_Mod calibration ratios
column13: Undocumented ad-hoc calibration factors applied to the user's simulated ISR; not present in the batch path.

name: IVA_Mod IVA in IEPS base
user_facing_web: IEPS computation strips a fixed 16 % IVA

name: rate limits (web)
default_value: 100 runs/IP per 600 s; 3 concurrent Stata; retry 30 s; slot TTL 600 s
